firstLoadJS.description: First-load JS bundle size (bytes, gzipped). Turbopack interim budget (2560KB max / 2400KB warn). Turbopack emits all code as flat shared chunks so first-load JS equals total JS — the 250KB webpack target (ADR Decision 5) is not applicable until MapLibre tree-shaking + route-level code-splitting land.

allPagesJS.description: Total JS across all chunks (bytes, gzipped). Turbopack interim budget (2560KB max / 2400KB warn). Equals firstLoadJS because Turbopack uses a flat shared-chunk layout with no app/ or pages/ subdirectory.

fcp.description: First Contentful Paint (ms). Turbopack interim budget. Homepage FCP ~1400ms; showcase budget uses 1.5x factor so max * 1.5 must cover showcase variance (~2500ms).

lcp.description: Largest Contentful Paint (ms). Turbopack interim budget (4500ms max / 3500ms warn). Actual: 2918ms on desktop, 4003ms observed on dev-branch CI run — large variance. Showcase uses 1.5x factor (6750ms).

tti.description: Time to Interactive (ms). Turbopack interim budget. Actual ~5350-5520ms due to 2.4MB shared bundle parse time.
